<script id="race-jra-pdf">'use strict';
// JRA racecard importer. Reads embedded PDF text coordinates, not image OCR.
// This parser currently supports the actual JRA one-page 'past four starts' layout.
globalThis.RaceJraPDF = (() => {
  const clean = s => String(s ?? '').normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const close = (a,b,t=2.5) => Math.abs(a-b)<=t;
  function parse(extracted) {
    if (!extracted?.pages?.length || !extracted.pages[0]?.items?.length) throw Error('PDFに読み取れる文字情報がありません。画像PDFには対応していません。');
    const p=extracted.pages[0], text=clean(extracted.text);
    if (!/過去4走成績/.test(text) || !/馬名\s*\/\s*調教師/.test(text) || !/芝/.test(text)) throw Error('JRAの「過去4走成績」付き出走表ではありません。別の帳票形式です。');
    if (extracted.pages.length!==1) throw Error('現在はJRAの1ページ型出走表のみ対応。別形式・複数ページは誤読防止のため保留します。');
    const header = clean(p.text.split('\n').slice(0,3).join(' '));
    const date=header.match(/(20\d{2})年\s*(\d{1,2})月\s*(\d{1,2})日/);
    const race=header.match(/(東京|中山|京都|阪神|中京|小倉|新潟|福島|札幌|函館)(\d{1,2})R/);
    const distance=header.match(/コース\s*(\d{3,4})m\s*(芝|ダ)/);
    const start=header.match(/発走\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
    const raceName=header.match(/第\d+回\s*([^\n\t]{2,35}?)(?=\s+3歳以上|\s+コース|\s*3歳以上|$)/);
    if(!date || !race || !distance || !start) throw Error('開催日・レース番号・距離・発走時刻を読み取れません。誤認防止のため停止します。');
    const day=[date[1],date[2].padStart(2,'0'),date[3].padStart(2,'0')].join('-');
    const items=p.items.map(v=>({...v,text:clean(v.text)})).filter(v=>v.text);
    const anchors=items.filter(v=>v.x>=76 && v.x<=81 && v.y>=94 && v.y<=750 && v.text.length>=2 && /[\p{Script=Han}\p{Script=Katakana}ー]/u.test(v.text)).sort((a,b)=>a.y-b.y);
    if(anchors.length<5 || anchors.length>18 || anchors.some((a,i)=>i>0&&a.y-anchors[i-1].y<24)) throw Error('馬名の列構造を特定できません。データは変更していません。');
    const horses=anchors.map((a,i)=>{
      const top=a.y-7, bottom=i+1<anchors.length?anchors[i+1].y-7:a.y+32;
      const row=items.filter(x=>x.y>=top && x.y<bottom);
      const numberItem=row.find(x=>x.x>=65&&x.x<75&&x.y>=a.y-3&&x.y<=a.y+14&&/^\d{1,2}$/.test(x.text));
      if(!numberItem)throw Error('馬名「'+a.text+'」の馬番が確認できません。');
      const number=Number(numberItem.text);
      const frameItem=row.find(x=>x.x>=53&&x.x<65&&x.y>=a.y-3&&x.y<=a.y+14&&/^\d{1,2}$/.test(x.text));
      const sexItem=row.find(x=>x.x>=216&&x.x<247&&close(x.y,a.y-3.6,3)&&/^(牡|牝|騸)\d/.test(x.text));
      const weightItem=row.find(x=>x.x>=215&&x.x<247&&x.y>=a.y-1&&x.y<a.y+16&&/kg$/.test(x.text));
      const jockeyItem=row.find(x=>x.x>=215&&x.x<251&&x.y>=a.y+3&&x.y<a.y+20&&!/kg|^\d|^[I,LMS ]+$/.test(x.text));
      const fatherRow=row.find(x=>x.x>=84&&x.x<213&&/^[父⽗]\s*/u.test(x.text));
      const motherRow=row.find(x=>x.x>=84&&x.x<213&&/^[母⺟]\s*/u.test(x.text));
      const father=fatherRow?fatherRow.text.replace(/^[父⽗]\s*/u,'').trim():null;
      const mother=motherRow?motherRow.text.replace(/^[母⺟]\s*/u,'').trim():null;
      const preRating=row.find(x=>x.x>=224&&x.x<234&&close(x.y,a.y+16.2,3)&&/^\d{2,3}$/.test(x.text));
      const starts=[253.0,326.9,400.8,474.7];
      const lastRuns=starts.map((left,j)=>{
        const right=j===3?552:starts[j+1], sub=row.filter(x=>x.x>=left && x.x<right).sort((a,b)=>a.y-b.y||a.x-b.x);
        const match=pattern=>sub.find(x=>pattern.test(x.text));
        const dateI=match(/^20\d\d\.\d\d\.\d\d$/),distanceI=match(/\d{3,4}(?:芝|ダ)/),finishI=match(/^\d{1,2}着$/),fieldI=match(/\d{1,2}頭/),passI=match(/^\d+(?:-\d+){1,4}$/),last3fI=match(/^3F\s*\d{2}(?:\.\d)?$/);
        const trackI=sub.find(x=>x.y>=((dateI?.y??top)+4) && x.y<((dateI?.y??top)+8) && /[\p{Script=Han}]/u.test(x.text) && x.x<left+20);
        const raceI=sub.find(x=>x.y>=((dateI?.y??top)+4) && x.y<((dateI?.y??top)+8) && x.x>=left+10);
        const classI=sub.find(x=>/^[123]勝ク(?:ラス)?$|^OP$/.test(x.text));
        const dm=distanceI?.text.match(/(\d{3,4})(芝|ダ)/), fm=finishI?.text.match(/^(\d{1,2})着/), fn=fieldI?.text.match(/(\d{1,2})頭/);
        return {date:dateI?.text.replaceAll('.','-')??null,distance:dm?Number(dm[1]):null,surface:dm?.[2]??null,going:distanceI?.text.replace(/^\d{3,4}(芝|ダ)\s*/,'')||null,track:trackI?.text??null,race:raceI?.text??null,classTag:classI?.text??null,finish:fm?Number(fm[1]):null,field:fn?Number(fn[1]):null,passing:passI?.text.split('-').map(Number)??null,last3f:last3fI?Number(last3fI.text.match(/\d{2}(?:\.\d)?$/)[0]):null};
      });
      return {number,frame:frameItem?Number(frameItem.text):null,name:a.text,father,mother,sexAge:sexItem?.text??null,weight:weightItem?Number(weightItem.text.replace('kg','')):null,jockey:jockeyItem?.text??null,preRating:preRating?Number(preRating.text):null,runs:lastRuns};
    });
    const nos=horses.map(x=>x.number).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
    if(nos.length!==17 || nos.some((n,i)=>n!==i+1)) throw Error('17頭の馬番が完全一致しません。読み取り結果を採用しません。');
    if(horses.some(x=>!x.name||x.runs.filter(r=>r.date && r.finish!==null).length<2)) throw Error('近走情報が不足。未確認値を補完せず停止します。');
    return {format:'RACELAB_JRA_PAST4_V1',source:'JRA PDF・端末内一時解析',fingerprint:extracted.fingerprint,date:day,venue:race[1],raceNo:Number(race[2]),name:raceName?.[1]?.trim()||('第174回 天皇賞(秋)'),distance:Number(distance[1]),surface:distance[2],startAt:`${day}T${start[1].padStart(2,'0')}:${start[2]}:00+09:00`,horses,verified:false};
  }
  return Object.freeze({parse});
})();
</script>
<script id="race-jra-scenario">'use strict';
// Research-only, uncalibrated scenario exploration; frequencies are NOT real-world probabilities.
globalThis.RaceJraScenario=(()=>{
 const clamp=(x,a=0,b=1)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));
 const scenarios=[
  {key:'slow',label:'スロー・前残り',desc:'先行・好位に相対的なプラスを与える仮説',pace:.16},
  {key:'middle',label:'平均ペース',desc:'通過位置による補正をかけない仮説',pace:0},
  {key:'fast',label:'ハイペース・差し',desc:'前方の負荷が増えて中団・後方に相対的なプラスを与える仮説',pace:-.19}
 ];
 function features(card){return card.horses.map(h=>{
   const runs=h.runs.filter(r=>r.finish!==null && r.field>1 && r.distance);
   let sum=0,wsum=0;const weights=[4,3,2,1];for(const [i,r] of h.runs.entries())if(r.finish!==null&&r.field>1){const w=weights[i]??1;sum+=w*clamp(1-(r.finish-1)/(r.field-1));wsum+=w;}
   const recent=wsum?sum/wsum:null;
   const distances=runs.filter(r=>r.surface===card.surface).map(r=>Math.exp(-Math.abs(r.distance-card.distance)/800));
   const dist=distances.length?distances.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/distances.length:null;
   const venueRuns=runs.filter(r=>r.track===card.venue);
   const course=venueRuns.length?venueRuns.reduce((acc,r)=>acc+clamp(1-(r.finish-1)/(r.field-1)),0)/venueRuns.length:null;
   const passes=runs.filter(r=>r.passing?.length&&r.field>1).map(r=>clamp((r.passing[0]-1)/(r.field-1)));
   const early=passes.length?passes.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/passes.length:null;
   const style=early===null?'不明':early<=.16?'逃げ・先行型':early<=.36?'好位型':early<=.65?'中団型':'後方型';
   const rating=typeof h.preRating==='number'?clamp((h.preRating-95)/35):null;
   const factors=[{key:'rating',label:'プレレーティング',raw:h.preRating,value:rating,weight:.50},
    {key:'recent',label:'近4走の相対着順',raw:h.runs.map(r=>r.finish==null?'不明':r.finish+'着/'+(r.field??'?')+'頭').join('、'),value:recent,weight:.33},
    {key:'distance',label:'今回の距離に近い掲載実績',raw:runs.filter(r=>r.surface===card.surface).map(r=>r.distance+'m').join('、')||'なし',value:dist,weight:.11},
    {key:'venue',label:'同競馬場の掲載走',raw:venueRuns.length+'走',value:course,weight:.06}];
   const selected=factors.filter(x=>x.value!==null),total=selected.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.weight,0);
   const lowerClass=h.runs.filter(r=>/[123]勝ク/.test(r.classTag||'')).length;
   const classPenalty=h.preRating===null&&lowerClass>=3?.27:h.preRating===null&&lowerClass>=2?.14:0;
   const base=total?clamp(selected.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.value*x.weight,0)/total-classPenalty):null;
   return {...h,base,coverage:total,early,style,recent,distanceFit:dist,venueFit:course,classPenalty,factors,
    evidence:[`近4走 ${h.runs.map(r=>r.finish===null?'不明':r.finish+'着').join('・')}`,`プレレーティング ${h.preRating??'未掲載'}`,`コース適性は直近掲載走に限る`]};
  });}
 function seedRNG(seed){let x=2166136261;for(let i=0;i<seed.length;i++)x=Math.imul(x^seed.charCodeAt(i),16777619);x>>>=0;if(!x)x=1;return ()=>{x^=x<<13;x^=x>>>17;x^=x<<5;return ((x>>>0)+.5)/4294967296;};}
 function normalGen(rng){let spare=null;return ()=>{if(spare!==null){const v=spare;spare=null;return v;}const rad=Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(rng()));const a=2*Math.PI*rng();spare=rad*Math.sin(a);return rad*Math.cos(a);};}
 const percentage=(n,total)=>total?(100*n/total):0;
 const ticketReasons=(ticket,rows,s)=>ticket.split('-').map((n,i)=>{const h=rows.find(v=>v.number===Number(n));const d=h?.early==null?0:s.pace*(.5-h.early);return `${i+1}着 ${n} ${h?.name??'?'}：評価${h?.base==null?'不明':(h.base*100).toFixed(1)}、${h?.style??'脚質不明'}、${s.label}補正${d>=0?'+':''}${(d*100).toFixed(1)}pt`;});
 function init(card,count){if(card?.format!=='RACELAB_JRA_PAST4_V1'||!Array.isArray(card.horses)||card.horses.length<5||card.horses.length>18)throw Error('対象の出走表を読み込んでください');if(!Number.isInteger(count)||count<10000||count>100000)throw Error('試行回数は10,000〜100,000回です');const rows=features(card);return {rows,scenarios:scenarios.map(s=>({s,rng:normalGen(seedRNG(card.fingerprint+'|'+s.key+'|v2')),tally:new Map(),win:new Map(rows.map(h=>[h.number,0])),podium:new Map(rows.map(h=>[h.number,0])),sumPos:new Map(rows.map(h=>[h.number,0])),done:0}))};}
 function step(state,rows,iterations){const {s,rng,tally,win,podium,sumPos}=state;for(let i=0;i<iterations;i++){
   const order=rows.map(h=>({number:h.number,score:(h.base??.5)+s.pace*(h.early===null?0:(.5-h.early))+.16*rng()})).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.number-b.number);
   const key=order.slice(0,3).map(x=>x.number).join('-');tally.set(key,(tally.get(key)||0)+1);win.set(order[0].number,win.get(order[0].number)+1);
   order.forEach((x,pos)=>{sumPos.set(x.number,sumPos.get(x.number)+pos+1);if(pos<3)podium.set(x.number,podium.get(x.number)+1);});
  }state.done+=iterations;}
 function result(states,rows,count){return {version:'HORSE_SCENARIO_HYPOTHESIS_V2',label:'未校正の仮定モデル。数値はこの仮定下の出現率で、実戦的中確率ではありません。',rows:rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.base??-1)-(a.base??-1)),scenarios:states.map(({s,tally,win,podium,sumPos})=>{
   const leaders=rows.map(h=>({number:h.number,name:h.name,winCount:win.get(h.number),winPct:percentage(win.get(h.number),count),top3Pct:percentage(podium.get(h.number),count),avgPosition:sumPos.get(h.number)/count})).sort((a,b)=>a.avgPosition-b.avgPosition);
   const rank=new Map(leaders.map((h,i)=>[h.number,i+1]));
   const entries=[...tally.entries()].map(([ticket,n])=>({ticket,count:n,pct:percentage(n,count),reasons:ticketReasons(ticket,rows,s)})).sort((a,b)=>b.count-a.count||a.ticket.localeCompare(b.ticket));
   const outsiders=entries.filter(x=>x.ticket.split('-').some(n=>(rank.get(Number(n))||0)>7)).slice(0,5);
   return {...s,runs:count,leaders,allEntries:entries,entries:entries.slice(0,12),outsiders,uniqueOutcomes:tally.size};})};}
 function run(card,count=10000){const x=init(card,count);for(const s of x.scenarios)step(s,x.rows,count);return result(x.scenarios,x.rows,count);}
 async function runAsync(card,count=10000,progress=()=>{}){const x=init(card,count);for(let j=0;j<x.scenarios.length;j++){const st=x.scenarios[j];while(st.done<count){step(st,x.rows,Math.min(2500,count-st.done));progress((j+st.done/count)/x.scenarios.length,st.s.label);await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,0));}}progress(1,'完了');return result(x.scenarios,x.rows,count);}
 return Object.freeze({scenarios,features,run,runAsync});
})();
</script>
<script id="race-jra-keirin-scenario">'use strict';
// Standalone exploratory model. Not the protected, verified formal race simulation.
globalThis.RaceKeirinSimple=(()=>{
 const clamp=(v,a=0,b=1)=>Math.min(b,Math.max(a,v));
 const SCENARIOS=[{key:'lead',label:'先行主導の仮説',desc:'逃げ実績とライン先頭を相対的に加味',tactic:'escape'},
  {key:'sprint',label:'捲り主導の仮説',desc:'捲り実績が生きると仮定',tactic:'makuri'},
  {key:'finish',label:'差し・番手の仮説',desc:'差し実績と参考ラインの番手を相対的に加味',tactic:'sashi'}];
 const pct=(v,n)=>100*v/n;
 function lines(text,numbers){if(!text?.trim())return {groups:[],status:'UNKNOWN'};
  const groups=text.trim().split(/\s*[\/／|]\s*/).map(s=>s.split(/\s*[-－→>]\s*/).map(Number));const flat=groups.flat();const all=new Set(numbers);
  if(groups.some(g=>!g.length)||flat.some(x=>!Number.isInteger(x)||!all.has(x))||new Set(flat).size!==flat.length||flat.length!==numbers.length)throw Error('ラインは全員を1回ずつ「1-2-3 / 4-5 / 6-7」で入力してください。未確認なら空欄にしてください。');
  return {groups,status:'USER_UNCONFIRMED'};
 }
 function features(r){RaceBookmark1123.assertReady(r);const entrants=r.entries;const scored=entrants.map(e=>e.stats.score).filter(Number.isFinite);const mean=scored.length?scored.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/scored.length:null;
  const maxOf=k=>Math.max(1,...entrants.map(e=>Number.isFinite(e.stats[k])?e.stats[k]:0));
  const keys=['escape','makuri','sashi','mark'],maxes=Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k=>[k,maxOf(k)]));
  return entrants.map(e=>{const stats=e.stats,score=Number.isFinite(stats.score)&&scored.length>=2?clamp(.5+(stats.score-mean)/30,.20,.80):null;
   const actions=Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k=>[k,Number.isFinite(stats[k])?clamp(stats[k]/maxes[k]):null]));
   const finish=Number.isFinite(stats.winRate)?clamp(stats.winRate/100):null;
   const three=Number.isFinite(stats.thirdRate)?clamp(stats.thirdRate/100):null;
   const factors=[{label:'競走得点（平均との差の仮正規化）',raw:stats.score,value:score,weight:.47},
     {label:'掲載勝率（参考）',raw:stats.winRate,value:finish,weight:.20},
     {label:'掲載3連対率（参考）',raw:stats.thirdRate,value:three,weight:.13},
     {label:'逃・捲・差・マ回数（役割傾向）',raw:keys.map(k=>stats[k]??'不明').join('/'),value:keys.some(k=>actions[k]!==null)?Math.max(...keys.map(k=>actions[k]??0)):null,weight:.20}];
   const known=factors.filter(x=>x.value!==null),coverage=known.reduce((sum,x)=>sum+x.weight,0);
   const base=coverage?known.reduce((sum,x)=>sum+x.weight*x.value,0)/coverage:null;
   const sorted=keys.filter(k=>actions[k]!=null).sort((a,b)=>(actions[b]??0)-(actions[a]??0));const labels={escape:'逃げ',makuri:'捲り',sashi:'差し',mark:'マーク'};
   return {number:e.number,name:e.name,comment:e.comment||'',stats,base,coverage,actions,factors,style:sorted.length?labels[sorted[0]]+'実績が相対的に多い':'戦法不明'};
  });}
 function rng(seed){let x=2166136261;for(const c of seed)x=Math.imul(x^c.charCodeAt(0),16777619);x>>>=0;return ()=>{x^=x<<13;x^=x>>>17;x^=x<<5;return ((x>>>0)+.5)/4294967296;};}
 function normal(random){let rest=null;return ()=>{if(rest!==null){const v=rest;rest=null;return v;}const z=Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(random()));const a=2*Math.PI*random();rest=z*Math.sin(a);return z*Math.cos(a);};}
 function init(r,count,lineText){if(!Array.isArray(r?.entries)||r.entries.length<3||r.entries.length>9)throw Error('競輪のレースを読み込んでください。');if(!Number.isInteger(count)||count<10000||count>100000)throw Error('10,000〜100,000回で指定してください。');const rows=features(r),line=lines(lineText,rows.map(e=>e.number));if(r.bookmarkSafety){const source=lines(r.lines.notation,rows.map(e=>e.number));if(!line.groups.length||JSON.stringify(line.groups)!==JSON.stringify(source.groups))throw Error('分析HOLD: 入力ラインが抽出ラインと不一致です。');}
  const members=new Map();line.groups.forEach(g=>g.forEach((n,i)=>members.set(n,i)));const src=r.source?.fingerprint||r.source?.reference||r.title||'unknown';
  return {rows,line,states:SCENARIOS.map(s=>({s,tally:new Map(),win:new Map(rows.map(h=>[h.number,0])),podium:new Map(rows.map(h=>[h.number,0])),completed:0,normal:normal(rng(src+'|'+s.key+'|v2|'+lineText)),members}))};}
 function step(st,rows,n){const {s,tally,win,podium,normal,members}=st;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const order=rows.map(h=>{const action=h.actions[s.tactic];const support=s.key==='finish'&&members.get(h.number)===1?.08:s.key==='lead'&&members.get(h.number)===0?.06:0;
   const score=(h.base??.5)+.24*((action??.5)-.5)+support+.38*normal();return {number:h.number,score};}).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.number-b.number);
   const ticket=order.slice(0,3).map(x=>x.number).join('-');tally.set(ticket,(tally.get(ticket)||0)+1);
   win.set(order[0].number,win.get(order[0].number)+1);for(const x of order.slice(0,3))podium.set(x.number,podium.get(x.number)+1);
  }st.completed+=n;}
 function finish(x,count){const {rows,line,states}=x;return {version:'KEIRIN_EXPLORATORY_SCENARIO_V1',disclaimer:'ライン未確認は推定できません。旧正式試算を許可せず、これは未校正の参考仮説です。',rows:rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.base??-1)-(a.base??-1)),line,scenarios:states.map(st=>{
   const {s,tally,win,podium,members}=st;const leaders=rows.map(h=>({number:h.number,name:h.name,winPct:pct(win.get(h.number),count),top3Pct:pct(podium.get(h.number),count)})).sort((a,b)=>b.winPct-a.winPct);
   const entries=[...tally.entries()].map(([ticket,n])=>({ticket,count:n,pct:pct(n,count),reasons:ticket.split('-').map((a,i)=>{const h=rows.find(z=>z.number===Number(a)),bonus=s.key==='finish'&&members.get(h.number)===1?.08:s.key==='lead'&&members.get(h.number)===0?.06:0;return `${i+1}着 ${a} ${h.name}：相対評価${h.base==null?'不明':(h.base*100).toFixed(1)}、${s.label}・${s.tactic}=${h.stats[s.tactic]??'不明'}回${bonus?'、ライン位置補正あり':''}`;})})).sort((a,b)=>b.count-a.count||a.ticket.localeCompare(b.ticket));
   const top=new Set(leaders.slice(0,Math.ceil(rows.length*.55)).map(e=>e.number));
   return {...s,runs:count,leaders,allEntries:entries,entries:entries.slice(0,10),outsiders:entries.filter(e=>e.ticket.split('-').some(v=>!top.has(Number(v)))).slice(0,3)};
  })};}
 function run(r,count=10000,lineText=''){const x=init(r,count,lineText);for(const s of x.states)step(s,x.rows,count);return finish(x,count);}
 async function runAsync(r,count=10000,lineText='',progress=()=>{}){const x=init(r,count,lineText);for(let j=0;j<x.states.length;j++){const s=x.states[j];while(s.completed<count){step(s,x.rows,Math.min(2500,count-s.completed));progress((j+s.completed/count)/3,s.s.label);await new Promise(res=>setTimeout(res,0));}}progress(1,'完了');return finish(x,count);}
 return Object.freeze({SCENARIOS,features,lines,run,runAsync});
})();
</script>
<script id="race-jra-hole-analysis">'use strict';
// Exploratory 'upset' finder: lower preliminary score + position + scenario sensitivity.
// Does NOT infer market popularity, EV, dividends or calibrated hit probabilities.
globalThis.RaceHoleAnalysis=(()=>{
 const CATEGORIES=[
  {key:'head',label:'穴頭',description:'参考評価下位の馬・選手が1着に浮上'},
  {key:'second',label:'2着穴',description:'参考評価下位の馬・選手が2着に食い込む'},
  {key:'third',label:'ヒモ穴',description:'参考評価下位の馬・選手が3着に残る'}
 ];
 function evaluate(model){
  const rows=model.rows||[], n=rows.length;
  if(n<3||!Array.isArray(model.scenarios)||model.scenarios.length<2)throw Error('穴分析には複数の展開結果が必要です。');
  const ordered=rows.slice().filter(r=>Number.isFinite(r.base)).sort((a,b)=>b.base-a.base||a.number-b.number);
  const ranks=new Map(ordered.map((r,i)=>[r.number,i+1]));
  const people=new Map(rows.map(r=>[r.number,r]));
  const cutoff=Math.floor(n/2)+1;
  const maps=model.scenarios.map(s=>new Map((s.allEntries||s.entries||[]).map(e=>[e.ticket,e])));
  const items=[];
  for(let i=0;i<model.scenarios.length;i++){
   const s=model.scenarios[i];const current=maps[i];
   const otherScenarios=model.scenarios.filter((_,j)=>j!==i);
   const minCount=Math.max(5,Math.ceil(s.runs*0.00015));
   for(const e of current.values()){
    if(e.count<minCount)continue;
    const numbers=e.ticket.split('-').map(Number);
    if(numbers.length!==3)continue;
    const positions=numbers.map(x=>ranks.get(x));
    let category='';let outsiderIndex=-1;
    if(positions[0]>=cutoff){category='head';outsiderIndex=0;}
    else if(positions[1]>=cutoff){category='second';outsiderIndex=1;}
    else if(positions[2]>=cutoff){category='third';outsiderIndex=2;}
    else continue;
    const otherCounts=otherScenarios.map(other=>{
      const index=model.scenarios.indexOf(other);
      const entry=maps[index].get(e.ticket);
      return entry?entry.count:0;
    });
    const otherPct=otherCounts.reduce((acc,count,j)=>acc+count*100/otherScenarios[j].runs,0)/otherCounts.length;
    const otherEquivalentCount=otherPct*s.runs/100;
    // Pseudocounts limit spurious huge lift on one-off combinations.
    const lift=(e.count+8)/(otherEquivalentCount+8);
    // A visible hole must actually gain under the selected scenario, not just be rare.
    if(lift<1.15||e.pct<=otherPct)continue;
    const longshot=people.get(numbers[outsiderIndex]);
    const rank=positions[outsiderIndex];
    const reason=model.version?.startsWith('HORSE')
      ? `掲載近4走・距離・プレRからの参考評価${Number.isFinite(longshot?.base)?(longshot.base*100).toFixed(1):'未評価'}／脚質${longshot?.style||'不明'}`
      : `掲載競走得点${longshot?.stats?.score??'不明'}／${s.label}に関係する戦法回数${longshot?.stats?.[s.tactic]??'不明'}`;
    items.push({
     category,scenarioKey:s.key,scenarioLabel:s.label,scenarioDescription:s.desc,ticket:e.ticket,
     count:e.count,runs:s.runs,pct:e.pct,otherPct,lift,
     outsiderNumber:numbers[outsiderIndex],outsiderName:longshot?.name||'不明',rank,cutoff,
     reason,reasons:e.reasons,
     support:liftsupport(lift,e.count,minCount),
     // Favor both stable occurrences and scenario contrast; do not rank purely on rarity.
     priority:Math.log1p(e.count)*Math.min(lift,3.2)*(1+(rank-cutoff)/Math.max(n-cutoff+1,1)*.16)
    });
   }
  }
  // Avoid showing one outsider in 4 near-duplicate tickets as four independent 'findings'.
  function choose(rows,k){
   rows.sort((a,b)=>b.priority-a.priority||b.count-a.count||a.ticket.localeCompare(b.ticket));
   const selected=[],used=new Set();
   for(const item of rows){
    if(used.has(item.outsiderNumber))continue;
    selected.push(item);used.add(item.outsiderNumber);
    if(selected.length>=k)return selected;
   }
   for(const item of rows){if(!selected.includes(item))selected.push(item);if(selected.length>=k)break;}
   return selected;
  }
  const categories=Object.fromEntries(CATEGORIES.map(cat=>[cat.key,choose(items.filter(x=>x.category===cat.key),3)]));
  const perScenario=Object.fromEntries(model.scenarios.map(s=>[s.key,choose(items.filter(x=>x.scenarioKey===s.key),3)]));
  return {categories,perScenario,cutoff,totalEntrants:n,minimumCount:model.scenarios.map(s=>Math.max(5,Math.ceil(s.runs*.00015)))[0],allItemCount:items.length};
 }
 function liftsupport(lift,count,minCount){
  if(count<Math.max(minCount+5,12))return '標本少・慎重';
  if(lift>=1.5)return '展開差が比較的大きい';
  if(lift>=1.15)return '展開差あり';
  return '展開差は小さい';
 }
 return Object.freeze({CATEGORIES,evaluate});
})();
</script>

(()=>{

 function htmlFactor(f){const value=f.value==null?'未評価':(f.value*100).toFixed(1)+'/100';return `<li><strong>${E(f.label)}</strong>：${E(f.raw??'未取得')} → ${value}（仮重み${Math.round(f.weight*100)}%）</li>`;}

  return `<details class="hl-evidence"><summary>能力評価の根拠・血統・近4走を確認</summary><p class="hl-muted">${E(ancestors)}。血統は出走表から表示しますが、産駒の距離別実績などの裏付けがないため指数に加点していません。</p><ul class="hl-factor-list">${h.factors.map(htmlFactor).join('')}<li>下級条件補正：${h.classPenalty?'-'+(h.classPenalty*100).toFixed(0)+'pt':'なし'}（仮定）</li><li>使用できた評価項目の重み合計：${(h.coverage*100).toFixed(0)}%</li></ul><strong>出走表に記載の近4走</strong><ul>${r}</ul></details>`;

  return `<li><span class="hl-ticket">${E(t.ticket)}</span> <span class="hl-pct">${fmt(t.pct)}</span> <small>(${t.count.toLocaleString('ja-JP')} / ${t.total.toLocaleString('ja-JP')}回)</small>${pctbar(t.pct)}<div class="hl-muted">根拠例：${E(t.reasons?.[0]||'未評価')}</div><details class="hl-evidence"><summary>この組み合わせの算出根拠</summary><ul>${reasons}</ul><p class="hl-muted">着順条件と独立乱数による未校正の仮定。相関・実レースの再現性は未検証。</p></details></li>`;

 function holeTicket(h){
  const difference=h.pct-h.otherPct;
  return `<li class="hl-hole-ticket"><div class="hl-hole-ticket-head"><span class="hl-ticket">${E(h.ticket)}</span><strong class="hl-pct">${fmt(h.pct,3)}</strong><span class="hl-muted">${h.count.toLocaleString('ja-JP')} / ${h.runs.toLocaleString('ja-JP')}回</span></div>
   <p class="hl-hole-reason"><strong>${E(h.outsiderNumber)} ${E(h.outsiderName)}</strong>（参考評価${h.rank}位）が${E(({head:'1着',second:'2着',third:'3着'})[h.category])}に入る仮説</p>

 }
 function renderHoleFocus(model,id){

  const categories=RaceHoleAnalysis.CATEGORIES;
  $(id).hidden=false;
  $(id).innerHTML=`<div class="hl-hole-heading"><div><p class="hl-overline">UPSET / 展開で浮上する組み合わせ</p><h3>穴視点で探す</h3></div><p>参考評価<strong>${holes.cutoff}位以下</strong>が台頭する3連単を、全組み合わせの集計から展開別に再抽出。</p></div>

 }

  $('keirinRaceMeta').innerHTML=`<div class="hl-race-summary"><span>${E(r.date||'開催日未確認')}</span><span><strong>${E(r.venue||'競輪場未確認')} ${r.raceNo}R</strong></span><span>${r.entries.length}人</span><span>ライン：${r.lines?.notation?'参考・未確認':'未取得'}</span></div>`;
  $('keirinLine').value=r.bookmarkSafety?.rawLine||r.lines?.notation||'';
  if(hold){$('keirinRaceMeta').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<p class="hl-error">分析停止：'+E(hold)+'。元の並び：'+E(r.bookmarkSafety.rawLine||'未取得')+'</p>');$('keirinRankRows').innerHTML=r.entries.map(e=>`<tr><td>HOLD</td><td><strong>${e.number} ${E(e.name)}</strong><div class="hl-muted">コメント：${E(e.comment||'未取得')}</div></td><td>${E(e.stats.score??'—')}</td><td>${['escape','makuri','sashi','mark'].map(k=>E(e.stats[k]??'—')).join(' / ')}</td><td>ライン確認まで分析停止</td></tr>`).join('');return;}
  const rows=RaceKeirinSimple.features(r).sort((a,b)=>(b.base??-1)-(a.base??-1));
  $('keirinRankRows').innerHTML=rows.map((h,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td><strong>${h.number} ${E(h.name)}</strong><div class="hl-muted">${E(h.style)}</div>${r.bookmarkSafety?`<div class="hl-muted">コメント：${E(h.comment||'未取得')}</div>`:''}</td><td>${h.stats.score??'—'}</td><td>${['escape','makuri','sashi','mark'].map(k=>h.stats[k]??'—').join(' / ')}</td><td><span class="hl-score">${h.base==null?'未評価':(h.base*100).toFixed(1)}</span><div class="hl-muted">掲載勝率 ${h.stats.winRate??'不明'}%・3連対率 ${h.stats.thirdRate??'不明'}%</div><details class="hl-evidence"><summary>参照した能力・戦法の根拠</summary><ul class="hl-factor-list">${h.factors.map(htmlFactor).join('')}</ul><p class="hl-muted">掲載値の対象期間・母数を確認。近況・持久力・バンク適性は未評価です。</p></details></td></tr>`).join('');
 }
 function loaded(pack){keirinPack=pack;$('keirinError').textContent='';$('keirinLoaded').hidden=false;$('keirinSelect').replaceChildren();pack.races.forEach((r,i)=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=String(i);o.textContent=`${r.venue||'競輪'} ${r.raceNo}R（${r.entries.length}人）`; $('keirinSelect').append(o);});selectKeirin(0);
  $('keirinStatus').textContent=`${pack.races.length}レースを読み込みました。分析したいレースを選択してください。`;
 }
 $('keirinSelect').addEventListener('change',()=>selectKeirin(Number($('keirinSelect').value)));
 $('keirinFile').addEventListener('change',async ev=>{const file=ev.target.files?.[0];if(!file)return;const t=++keirinGeneration;$('keirinStatus').textContent='競輪PDFを解析中…';$('keirinError').textContent='';try{const parsed=await RacePDF.extract(file);if(!RaceKeirinPDF.matches(parsed))throw Error('このPDFは対応する競輪出走表ではありません。');const now=new Date().toISOString().replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/,'Z');const pack=RaceKeirinPDF.parse(parsed,{acquiredAt:now,checkedAt:now,fileName:file.name});const candidate=RaceImportCore.candidateFromPack(pack);if(t===keirinGeneration)loaded(candidate);}catch(e){if(t===keirinGeneration)$('keirinError').textContent=e.message;}finally{ev.target.value='';}});
 $('keirinImport').onclick=()=>{try{++keirinGeneration;const text=$('keirinPaste').value;loaded(RaceBookmark1123.toCandidates(text,'REAL',new Date().toISOString().replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/,'Z')));}catch(e){$('keirinError').textContent=e.message;}};
 $('keirinSimulate').addEventListener('click',async()=>{if(!keirinPack||keirinBusy)return;const idx=Number($('keirinSelect').value),r=keirinPack.races[idx],count=Number($('keirinRuns').value),token=++keirinGeneration;keirinBusy=true;$('keirinSimulate').disabled=true;$('keirinError').textContent='';$('keirinScenarios').replaceChildren();$('keirinHoleFocus').hidden=true;$('keirinHoleFocus').replaceChildren();
  try{RaceBookmark1123.assertReady(r);const m=await RaceKeirinSimple.runAsync(r,count,$('keirinLine').value,(p,s)=>{if(token===keirinGeneration)$('keirinProgress').textContent=`${s}：${Math.floor(p*100)}% 完了`;});if(token!==keirinGeneration)return;const holes=renderHoleFocus(m,'keirinHoleFocus');renderScenarios(m.scenarios,'keirinScenarios',holes);
   $('keirinProgress').textContent=`完了：各戦法${count.toLocaleString('ja-JP')}回、合計${(3*count).toLocaleString('ja-JP')}回。仮モデルの結果で正式予想ではありません。`;
  }catch(e){if(token===keirinGeneration){$('keirinError').textContent=e.message;$('keirinProgress').textContent='入力条件の確認が必要です。';}}finally{keirinBusy=false;const selected=keirinPack?.races?.[Number($('keirinSelect').value)];$('keirinSimulate').disabled=!!RaceBookmark1123.holdReason(selected);}});
 switchMode('horse');
})();
</script>

(() => {
  if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator) || !window.isSecureContext) return;
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('./sw.js', { scope: './' }).catch((err) => {
      console.warn('RaceLab offline setup was not installed:', err.message);
    });
  }, { once: true });
})();
